description.value: The Emily Carr Branch is a neighbourhood branch of the Greater Victoria Public Library system, located on Blanshard Street in Victoria. It provides public access to books, digital resources, and public computers as part of a multi-branch municipal library network. Touring cyclists passing through the north end of Victoria may find it a convenient urban pause point.
